rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a situation, arrangement, or state that is still changing or not settled.

example.english: The market situation is still fluid, and the plan may change at any time.
example.traditional: 呢排個市況仲唔穩定，計劃隨時都可能改。
example.jyutping: ni1 paai4 go3 si5 fong3 zung6 m4 wan2 ding6 gai3 waak6 ceoi4 si4 dou1 ho2 nang4 goi2

rows.note: Use this in financial contexts for an asset that can readily be converted into cash.

example.english: This kind of fund is fluid, so it can be turned into cash quickly when needed.
example.traditional: 呢類基金容易變現，急住用錢時好快就可以套現。
example.jyutping: ni1 leoi6 gei1 gam1 jung4 ji6 bin3 jin6 gap1 zyu6 jung6 cin2 si4 hou2 faai3 zau6 ho2 ji5 tou3 jin6

rows.note: Use this for movement, performance, or motion that proceeds smoothly and gracefully.

example.english: Their dance movements are fluid and easy to watch.
example.traditional: 佢跳舞嘅動作好流暢，睇落好舒服。
example.jyutping: keoi5 tiu3 mou5 ge3 dung6 zok3 hou2 lau4 coeng3 tai2 lok6 hou2 syu1 fuk6
